Doable, I think, but not until Captain Cosmic is out.  

 

The trick is that Coolant Blast will double the amount of fire damage AZ has taken this round.  Coolant Blast isn't limited, and there's two of them.  If you use Isothermic Transducer to hit yourself N times with each Coolant Blast, and you active Coolant Blast X times in a round, then the total damage AZ will take is on the order of N^X.  Dynamic Syphon allows you to turn damage into power uses (since you don't have to worry about losing the Syphon while Fixed Point is out), which means that it's fairly easy to use both Coolant Blasts every turn.  There are 7 turns in a round, which means a maximum of 14 power uses.  5^14 is 6 billion, and would only require 70 or so instances of dealing damage.  Even if you miss the environment or villain turn, 6^12 is 2 billion, and wouldn't take much longer.

 

Doing it the old fashion way by incrementally hitting yourself with a growing Isothermal Transducer charge deals AZ aproximately X^2 * N / 2 damage, where X is the number of times you damage yourself, and N is your damage boost.  Assuming a damage boost of 10 (hah!), it would take about 20,000 instances of damage to reach 2 billion.  You could reduce that a fair amount by capping it with a Coolant Blast, but that would still take over a thousand instances of damage to get there.

posts.cooked:
Imagine that AZ is hit with 5 fire damage.  He then hits his Dynamic Syphon, allowing him to use a power.  He uses Coolant Blast on Baron Blade, it is redirected back at AZ, so he takes 5.  IT (Isothermic Transducer) activates, and is Twist the Ethered so AZ hits himself for 5 fire damage (well, 6 actually, but I'm going to ignore damage boosts).  IT activates again, and AZ hits himself for 5 again.  IT activates again, and AZ hits himself again.  AZ has now taken a total of 20 fire damage, so when IT activates this time, he directs the damage at the Dynamic Syphon, allowing him to activate another power.  He uses his second Coolant Blast to deal 20 damage to Blade, which is redirected back to AZ.  IT activates, and AZ hits himself for 20.  repeat twice more, and AZ has now hit himself with 80 fire damage in total.

 

On the next turn, Ra shoots the Dynamic Syphon, allowing AZ to activate Coolant Blast for 80.  He hits himself 3 times, then hits the Dynamic Syphon and activates his second Coolant Blast for 320.  Hit himself 3 more times, and AZ has now taken 1,280 fire damage in total.

 

Actually, the forumula is F * (N+1)^X, where F = initial fire damage, N = hits per Coolant Blast, and X = Power uses.

In this case, F was 5, N was 3, and X was 4.  5*(3+1)^4 = 1,280.  Of course, this ignores the damage boosts that will increase the amount of damage you deal each time.

Promise made, promise kept.

 

This ran pretty much exactly as I described earlier.  Two Coolant Blasts, Dynamic Syphons on AZ and AA, Twist the Ether, and lots of damage.  Syphons were triggered by a Marsquake, Hasten Doom, and then on AA, Greatest Legacy, and Visionary's turns.  It was on Visionary's turn that I crossed the 2 billion threshold.  I was unable to do any damage with Captain Cosmic, on account of all his constructs being indestructible.  Took me about 2-3 hours in total.

 

Things I learned:

  1.  When a hero is dealt too much damage, their health rolls over to positive.  While at greater than max HP they cannot gain health, but lose health as normal. When Fixed Point was destroyed, it assumed that AZ was supposed to stay alive.

  2.  When the fire damage AZ has been dealt since his last turn rolls over, Coolant Blast gets a little strange.  I attached a screencap of what it does to the card.  And when you try to use the power, it just skips doing anything and moves on.  (Although the power is still considered used.  If you come back later and try to use it, it will be greyed out.)

  3.  Baron Blade's defeat image is not replaced by a smoldering pile of ash when he's been dealt over a billion damage.
